_comment: USER 2026-11-21: 'It seems like Cinder Pyromancer auto-taps in the viewer, but cannot be manually tapped. Let's leave the auto-tap, but add the option to manually tap.'

The human main-phase menu offers ONE standalone 'tap <pinger>' plan per READY pinger (TurnSolver::AppendHumanManualPingPlans): the untapped Pyromancer and the hasty (sick) Vulshok Sorcerer -- not the tapped Fireslinger, not the summoning-sick one. They are appended after every other plan; the Bolt lines are still there.

tap Vulshok Sorcerer: it deals 1 damage to any target
